title: 第7章 黄道吉日
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

明瑟真君敛眸，吩咐道：“此事不可让阿铃知晓，免得她神伤落寞。”

“这几日不要放外人到混元峰上来，也看着点阿铃，不要让她下山了。”

“是，师尊。”

第五齐和张流川两人躬身应道。

却不知这消息和铃早就知晓，而且想让她知晓的人还不少。

和铃手里的传音玉符亮了一下，传出声音来。

“夜师兄要成亲了，和铃你知道吗？”

是梁音儿。

她的声音有点哑，像是哭过，“两日之后，夜师兄就会和程芰荷结为道侣，届时程芰荷会献出自己的金丹。”

“和铃，你一定要阻止他们成亲，那个程芰荷根本就配不上夜师兄，你难道忍心看着他日后都要被一个丑八怪缠着吗？”

“你是明瑟真君的弟子，即使你大闹了夜师兄与程芰荷的婚礼，宗主也会看在明瑟真君的份上不与你计较的。”

和铃冷冷一笑。

把她当枪使呢？真当她还是从前那个被别人一句话就耍得团团转的和铃吗？

程芰荷这个献丹者是怎么选出来的，她猜也猜得到。

梁音儿自己喜欢夜弦，不愿他和别的女子成亲，却叫她去捣乱夜弦的婚礼，算盘打得也忒响了些。

【和铃……】狗系统畏畏缩缩道，【系统有新任务了，阻止夜弦和别的女子成亲。】

“这任务我不做，你也不要再提。”

和铃收起传音玉符，开始梳理原著剧情。

原著叫做《下神坛》，女主薛妙善是魔道宗门阴阳宗的少宗主，被派遣到南华宗卧底，解救大魔头殷神凝的。

据说殷神凝的手上掌握着有关魔教密藏的秘密，那是一笔滔天的财富，足以让任何人疯狂，南华宗对其只囚不杀，也有出于这方面的考虑。

按照原著情节，薛妙善是在夜弦和原身成亲后的下一个月来到南华宗的。

她在南华宗潜伏了半年之久，也没有找到关押殷神凝的地方，反而是对夜弦起了兴趣，几次三番示弱出现在他的面前。

和铃摩挲着腰间的碧玉宫铃，渐渐勾起嘴角。

薛妙善不知道殷神凝被关押在哪，她知道啊！

她得抢在薛妙善之前，从这个大魔头口中，骗到魔教密藏的藏宝图。

藏宝图应该是有九份的，她也不贪心，总之能骗多少是多少吧。

和铃想到了一个好日子。

两日之后，夜弦成亲，想必南华宗会很热闹。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

True Lord Mingse narrowed his eyes and ordered: "Don't let A Ling know about this matter, lest she feel hurt and lonely."

"Don't let outsiders come to Hunyuan Peak these days. Also keep an eye on A Ling and don't let her go down the mountain."

"Yes, Master."

Wu Qi and Zhang Liuchuan both bowed and responded.

Little did she know that Ling and Ling had known about this news for a long time, and there were many people who wanted her to know.

The sound transmission jade talisman in He Ling's hand lit up and a sound came out.

"Senior Brother Ye is getting married, do you know He Ling?"

It's Liang Yin'er.

Her voice was a little hoarse, as if she had cried, "In two days, Senior Brother Ye will become a Taoist couple with Cheng Zhihe, and Cheng Zhihe will donate his golden elixir at that time."

"He Ling, you must stop them from getting married. That Cheng Qianhe is not worthy of Senior Brother Ye at all. Can you bear to see him being haunted by an ugly monster in the future?"

"You are the disciple of True Lord Mingse. Even if you make a big fuss at the wedding between Senior Brother Ye and Cheng Qianhe, the sect leader will not care about you for the sake of True Lord Mingse."

He Ling smiled coldly.

How about using her as a gun user?Do you really think that she is still the same He Ling who was fooled around by others with just one word?

She could guess how Cheng Qianhe, the elixir donor, was selected.

Liang Yin'er liked Ye Xian herself and didn't want him to marry another woman, but she asked her to disrupt Ye Xian's wedding, which made her plan too loud.

[And Ling...] Dog System shrank and said, [The system has a new mission, to prevent Ye Xian from getting married to another woman.】

"I won't do this task, so don't mention it again."

He Ling put away the sound transmission jade talisman and began to sort out the plot of the original work.

The original work is called "Down to the Altar". The heroine Xue Miaoshan is the young master of the Yin Yang Sect of the demonic sect. She is sent to the Nanhua Sect as an undercover agent to rescue the great demon Yin Shenning.

It is said that Yin Shenning holds the secrets of the Demon Sect in his hands, which is a huge amount of wealth that is enough to drive anyone crazy. The Nanhua Sect only imprisoned him but not killed him for this reason.

According to the plot of the original work, Xue Miaoshan came to Nanhua Sect the month after Ye Xian and the original person got married.

She had been lurking in the Nanhua Sect for half a year, but she could not find the place where Yin Shenning was imprisoned. Instead, she became interested in Ye Xian and appeared in front of him several times to show weakness.

He Ling rubbed the jade palace bell around her waist and gradually raised the corners of her mouth.

Xue Miaoshan didn't know where Yin Shenning was being held, but she knew!

She had to get the treasure map secretly hidden by the Demon Cult from this big demon before Xue Miaoshan did.

There should be nine copies of the treasure map, and she's not greedy, so she can deceive as much as she can.

He Ling thought of a good day.

Two days later, Ye Xian will get married, and the Nanhua Sect will be very lively.
